header: Submitting a manuscript to the Quarterly
description: Submissions open twice a year and everything runs through Compass. Budget an hour for the first upload: the checklist is the slow part, and getting it right is what keeps the median first decision at 21 days.

items.title: Prepare the files
items.content: One anonymised manuscript as PDF, the analysis set as a separate archive, and a title page listing every author with an ORCID. Figures go in at 300 dpi or better.

items.title: Answer the checklist
items.content: Eleven questions on data availability, consent, funding and conflicts. The answers publish with the paper, so write them for a reader rather than for the desk.

items.title: Track the decision
items.content: Compass shows the handling editor and the current stage. Two referees read in parallel; expect a first decision in 21 days, and a note from us if it will take longer.
